basic_info.description: BUY OR TRADE! Don't miss this one-of-a-kind updated home in the highly desirable Sunset District – Excellent Top Rated Schools! Awesome ocean views, sunset skies, and minutes to beachside living! A short stroll to Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, SF Zoo, the Great Highway, Lake Merced, & SF State University plus more! This move-in-ready gem combines modern upgrades with timeless charm. Modern chef’s kitchen with granite countertops, sleek tile backsplash, stainless steel appliances, and gas stovetop. Beautiful updated bathrooms with contemporary finishes and tile accents. Hardwood floors throughout, dual-pane windows, and newer interior/exterior paint. Skylights in the kitchen and bath for abundant natural light. Split primary suite with window overlooking ocean views. Bonus flex room with sink and patio access – ideal as an office or guest room. Tesla charging station + 1-car garage. Landscaped front yard and low-maintenance backyard with a wood deck for entertaining. Bonus Opportunity: Approved ADU Blueprints for a 4-beds/4-baths – perfect for rental income or multigenerational living! This Sunset beauty offers immediate comfort and future potential – a rare opportunity this close to the coast.
